Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 5 now!
Synopsis:-
The celebration of Dhananand's birthday begins in the Magadha kingdom. Meanwhile, Chanakya and Bhairav decide to find out Murali among the crowd. Amatya Rakshas identifies Murali and replaces him with one of his men to trap Chanakya. During the celebration, a slave steals Dhananand's brooch who is killed by Dhananand. Despite Amatya Rakshas's plan, Chanakya successfully gets out of the trap. Chandragupta and his friends implement the first phase of their plan. Mura gives her expensive possession and saves a child from becoming a slave.
